I had braces done here before, and it was excellent! The orthodontist was very kind, and the counter staff provided great service.

However, I brought my boyfriend here for fillings, and the problems are recurring. They said they couldn't change doctors.

The first filling fell out the next day, requiring a follow-up appointment.

On the second visit, for the fix, my boyfriend experienced severe pain. Food particles were getting stuck in the filling – it was a poorly done filling. He constantly had to floss to remove it.

We called to schedule a fix, but the doctor was unavailable, with very long waiting times – sometimes only once a week, sometimes every two weeks. My boyfriend had to endure the pain. It was a huge waste of time and money, and the problems just wouldn't end.

I wasn't satisfied and asked to change doctors because I didn't trust them and feared the same thing would happen again. They said it wasn't possible.

Then, my boyfriend went to another clinic for tartar removal. They removed tartar from that same tooth where the filling was – and food particles were still trapped inside! How could they do that?

After things improved, we let it go. I don't even remember when the filling was done. Most recently, while flossing, the filling fell out!

I called the clinic, and they said they wouldn't cover it under warranty because it was over three months ago.

Terrible service. The problems keep recurring. Filling isn't cheap. The problem needs to be solved. If the doctor isn't skilled in this type of filling, they should have someone else handle it, or use a better method.
